defs.def: a dirty or untidy state 肮脏；杂乱；不整洁

ex.s: It can also just leave a big mess.
ex.t: 它也可能只留下一团糟。

ex.s: They may clear up other people’s mess.
ex.t: 他们可能会清理别人的烂摊子。

ex.s: When he got older, John started to wonder if this process could be used to clean up the messes people were making.
ex.t: 长大后，约翰开始想这个过程是否可以用来清理人类制造的垃圾。

ex.s: But the stove was a mess now.
But the stove was a mess now.
As I swept up the mess, I wondered why we had been breaking so many things over the months.
ex.t: 当我在打扫残局时我想为什么这几个月来我们打破了这么多东西。

ex.s: Never!” _3 “My fridge is a total mess!
ex.t: 绝不！”_3 ＂我的冰箱简直是一团糟！

defs.def: a situation that is full of problems, usually because of a lack of organization or because of mistakes that sb has made （组织欠佳或人为导致的）麻烦，困境，混乱

ex.s: We need the ability to work out which messes are worth avoiding — because however impressively fast you move, some things can’t be easily unbroken.
ex.t: 我们需要具备分辨哪些混乱值得避免的能力——因为无论你行动得多快，有些东西一旦打破就很难复原。

ex.s: It really messed up my relationship with food — something that took me years to overcome.
ex.t: 它确实弄糟了我与食物的关系——这是我花了多年才克服的。

ex.s: I really don’t think it’s worth the effort of spending so much time preparing for a single meal, and then another hour cleaning up the mess after its’ over.
ex.t: 我真的不认为花这么多时间准备一顿饭，然后在结束后再花一个小时清理烂摊子是值得的。

defs.def: a person who is dirty or whose clothes and hair are not tidy 不整洁（或邋遢、不修边幅）的人
a person who has serious problems and is in a bad mental condition 有严重问题且精神失常的人

ex.s: （10分）Haze Mabry， who has worked as a school keeper for thirteen years， walks into the school building every day and empties garbage cans， wipes down bathrooms and mops wet messes in the hallways．
ex.t: 21．（10分）Haze Mabry 在学校做了十三年保洁工，每天走进教学楼，清空垃圾桶，擦拭卫生间，拖干走廊上的湿污。

defs.def: the excrement (= solid waste matter) of an animal, usually a dog or cat （狗、猫等的）粪便
a lot of sth 许多；大量

ex.s: Mabry works circles around all the students， cleaning up messes others don't want to touch． He doesn't expect a lot． Mabry said he hadn't planned to do much for his milestone birthday，so he was happy the students had prepared the surprise celebration．
ex.t: 马布里围着所有学生忙碌，清理别人不愿碰的脏乱。他要求不多。马布里说他原本没有打算为这个里程碑式的生日做什么，所以学生们准备了这场惊喜庆祝活动，他很高兴。

defs.def: a building or room in which members of the armed forces have their meals （军队的）食堂，餐厅

ex.s: When I arrived home yesterday, my room was in a mess.
ex.t: 昨天我回到家时，我的房间一片狼藉。

defs.def: to make sth dirty or untidy 使不整洁；弄脏；弄乱

ex.s: It’s a good sign for the chef if you make a mess around your plate
ex.t: 如果你把盘子周围弄得一团糟，对厨师来说是好兆头

defs.def: to empty its bowels somewhere that it should not 随地便溺
to behave in a silly and annoying way, especially instead of doing sth useful 胡闹；瞎闹
to spend time doing sth for pleasure in a relaxed way 逍遥自在地做事
to touch or use sth in a careless and/or annoying way 乱弄；玩弄
to spend time playing with sth, repairing sth, etc. 花时间摆弄（或修理等）；瞎忙活
to cause sb to have serious emotional or mental problems 使心情恶劣；使精神崩溃
to physically hurt sb, especially by hitting them 使身体受伤；殴打
